vacancy_label: Synthetic vacancy; not a real opening

requirements.en: Supervise a fabrication team, allocate work and maintain training records.
requirements.zh: 监督制作团队，分配工作并维护培训记录。

requirements.en: Plan nonstructural exhibit fabrication from approved drawings and manage fit and finish checks.
requirements.zh: 依据获批图纸规划非结构性展陈制作，并管理适配及饰面检查。

requirements.en: Coordinate materials and workshop capacity while respecting purchasing and engineering approval limits.
requirements.zh: 协调材料与工坊产能，同时遵守采购及工程审批权限限制。

requirements.en: Preferred: hold independent sign-off authority for load-bearing exhibit structures.
requirements.zh: 优先：拥有承重展陈结构的独立签批权限。
